title: Quantum Integrated High-Performance Computing: Envisioning a Layered Architecture for Next-Generation Hybrid Computing Infrastructure
summary: High-performance computing (HPC) has evolved over decades through multiple architectural transitions, from vector supercomputers to massively parallel CPU clusters and GPU-accelerated systems, continuously expanding the frontier of scientific discovery. With the emergence of quantum processing units (QPUs) as practical computational accelerators, a new opportunity arises to further extend this trajectory by integrating quantum and classical computing paradigms.
